pressure test: refetch after fixing _strip_html, which blanked every HTML entity instead of decoding it. The stored text read 'Powell s Chairman' for 'Powell's' and 'T D backlog' for 'T&D'. This corpus is what the verbatim earnings-quote verifier checks quotes against, so a quote copied correctly from the real filing would have been rejected as fabricated, and any quote that did match would have printed on the stock page misquoted.
